purpose: Define the Expose DWH Monitor for inspecting local/remote bindings, EXT endpoints, origin/scope, remote dereferences and transport/session state without becoming a data or authorization authority.

topics.name: DWH Monitor
topics.purpose: Define the Expose DWH Monitor for inspecting local/remote bindings, EXT endpoints, origin/scope, remote dereferences and transport/session state without becoming a data or authorization authority.

semantics.action_rule: Endpoint/configuration/lifecycle changes invoke explicit canonical operations.
semantics.authority_rule: Monitor does not grant or bypass local/remote AccessCore authorization.
semantics.redaction_rule: Restricted payload/content/security metadata is redacted according to policy.
semantics.identity_rule: UI labels never replace canonical instance/endpoint/data identities.
semantics.transport_rule: Connection status is displayed separately from data availability/authority.

invariants.rule: DWH data movement preserves explicit origin identity, schema, scope and remote authority boundaries; transport connectivity never becomes data authority.

hard_gates.condition: monitor directly mutates governed DWH data without explicit operation
UI label used as endpoint/data identity

references.purpose: Monitor can trace governed remote dereferences.

prose.summary: Define the Expose DWH Monitor for inspecting local/remote bindings, EXT endpoints, origin/scope, remote dereferences and transport/session state without becoming a data or authorization authority.
